e1de1659d2.q: What is the Zoom Salute framing technique and how should you position yourself for video calls?
e1de1659d2.a: The Zoom Salute is a framing technique where you place your hand at the top of your forehead with your fingers touching the top of your head and your pinky finger touching the top of the frame. This ensures you are at the right distance from the camera. You should be able to almost touch your camera by holding out your hand, positioned at about a half inch away. The goal is to show a little bit of your shoulders and head in the frame, avoiding being too far back or too close.

d202e734e3.q: How should you arrange a home office bookshelf to appear professional on Zoom calls?
d202e734e3.a: Arrange your bookshelf intentionally to be visually interesting without distracting from the conversation. Use white space to allow the viewer's eye to pause. Position items with subtle spacing so that elements like mugs or artwork are clearly outlined. Keep functional office supplies like staplers and scissors out of the main frame. Use lower shelves for items you do not want on camera, such as printers. Create a peekaboo effect by placing plants or artwork in front of other items so they are partially visible but not fully distracting.

a8664cf727.q: Why should you use fake plants from Ikea instead of real plants for a home office?
a8664cf727.a: Fake plants from Ikea, which cost a couple of dollars each, are a practical alternative if you do not have a green thumb or cannot maintain real plants. In a sunken part of a house that gets really cold in the winter, real plants might die. Fake greenery provides visual appeal for video backgrounds without requiring maintenance or risking plant death in unfavorable conditions.

8753b0a21e.q: What positioning technique makes objects on a shelf more visible and defined on camera?
8753b0a21e.a: Move objects slightly so there is just a glimpse of white space on the outside, which allows you to make out the outline of the item. For example, a coffee bean mug positioned with a small amount of white space on the right-hand side makes the outline and handle of the mug clearly visible. Even fractions of inches of adjustment can make the difference between an object blending into the background and standing out clearly defined.
